title: Whose Truth? Pluralistic Geo-Alignment for (Agentic) AI

bias_targets.methodology: Proposes a formal mathematical framework evaluating the divergence (such as Kullback-Leibler divergence) between an AI system's output probability distribution and the locally appropriate target distribution for specific geographic contexts.
Evaluates the lack of localness and cultural sensitivity in AI outputs by proposing geographic alignment benchmarks based on regional societal norms, values, and legal realities.
